content.short: PLONK offers a universal trusted setup for efficient zk-SNARKs.
content.description: PLONK is a zk-SNARK proof system built to address Sonic's high-proof construction overheads. Unlike Groth16, which required circuit-specific setups, PLONK relies on a universal, continuously updatable trusted setup, enabling secure use across multiple circuits. This design delivers greater versatility and security, while achieving faster proving times and a succinct verification process. By enabling reuse of the same trusted setup across diverse circuits, PLONK supports scalable zk proofs for a range of applications.
